title: strokes@1: stroke order for one set of characters
description: strokes/<set>.jsonl. The first line is the header, naming the set, its box and its source; every later line is one character's strokes, in order, as SVG path data.

set.description: The set's id; must match the file name. Usually the script's key, as in characters@1.

box.description: Paths sit in a box this many units wide and high: 100 for the SquirrelGo writing pad, 109 for KanjiVG.

notes.description: How the strokes were drawn and checked, one sentence or line each.

source.description: Where the strokes come from, as listed in SOURCES.md, or that they were written for this project.

char.description: The character, or a pairing like きゃ, unique in the file. Klingon uses romanized letter names, since pIqaD sits in the Private Use Area.

strokes.description: One SVG path per stroke, in writing order, each drawn in its writing direction.

labels.description: KanjiVG sets: where each stroke's number is drawn, one [x, y] per stroke.
